RuntimeModule.Name: DustbornsV9
RuntimeModule.Title: Dustborns - Quests, Technologies and Census of Ash
RuntimeModule.Description: Фикс: x0.5 пром через PlanetPopulationIndustry Percent, старт 2+1 безвольный через MajorPopulation Count и HomeImprovement. Пыль: +8 Teeming неистощена, +4 средняя неистощена. Безвольные без политики, +3/+6 инд, без науки/влияния.
RuntimeModule.Author: Arena Agent
RuntimeModule.ReleaseNotes: 3.1 - EFFECT SECTIONS IN TECH TOOLTIPS (TooltipOverride): the Dustborns bonuses on the 11 vanilla tech variants (and First Hunger) now render as proper "Эффекты" bullet sections in the tech tooltip instead of plain description text and ugly auto-formatted binary-modifier lines. Raw mechanic modifiers are now TooltipHidden="true"; each effect descriptor carries a decorative Modifier with Path="FAKE" (never applies) + TooltipOverride="%Technology...Effect" localization key (vanilla pattern %NegatedLuxuryTooltipEffect, used by The Watchers). Variant descriptions restored to pure vanilla lore. New localization keys: TechnologyDustbornFoodToDust0/10/25Effect, TechnologyDustbornDigestion1-4Effect, TechnologyDustbornBezvolnyIndustry1Effect. 3.0 - TECH MERGE INTO VANILLA TECHS (variant techs, Horatio-style) + no more dissolving: (1) REMOVED "Dissolve Dustborn" (StarSystemImprovementSellMajorPopulationDustborns) - improvement, descriptor, gui and localization deleted; Dustborns can no longer be dissolved into production. (2) "Construct Dustborn" renamed to "Weave Dustborn" (Соткать Пылерождённого) in localization. (3) Standalone tech branches REMOVED: FoodToDust1/2/3 (Dry Harvest/Mass Dehydration/Total Dissolution), Digestion1/2/3 (Deep Digestion/Memory Extraction/Total Hydrolysis), Shells1 (Reinforced Shells); all TechnologyLinks deleted. (4) Their bonuses moved onto 11 VANILLA techs via faction VARIANT technologies (pattern of Horatio/Sophons): each base vanilla tech gains an Inverted PathPrerequisite for AffinityMappingDustborns (so Dustborns don't see the original), and a new variant "TechnologyDefinition...Dustborns" is created with a non-inverted prerequisite + the faction bonus descriptor; variant appears at the same X/Y in the tree with a new description section. Food-to-dust: Landscape Design (Planetary Landscaping) +10%, Botanical Scanning +25%, Chaotic Meteorology +25%, Autonomous Materials +25%, Colony Adaptation +25% (base 25% from First Hunger quest + 10% + 4x25% = 135% max). Digestion: Astrofinance +300, Chameleon Hubs +300, Xenoanthropology +300, Ultra-Durable Materials +300 (all additive "+300", not absolute 600/900; max 300+1200=1500). Shells: Reinforced Shells deleted; Autonomous Construction and Hardened Alloys each give +1 industry to Bezvolny (regular shells only, NOT Scholar shells). New descriptors: TechnologyDustbornFoodToDust10, TechnologyDustbornFoodToDust25, TechnologyDustbornDigestion4, TechnologyDustbornBezvolnyIndustry1; deleted obsolete descriptors (FoodToDust1/2/3, Shells1, TechnologyLink*). New file Simulation/ConstructibleElement_Science[VanillaTechs].xml + 11 variant TechnologyGuiElement2 (same X/Y + icons). Localization: 11 new variant title/description keys, removed old tech keys and Sell keys, updated faction/affinity/population descriptions (no more dissolving, food chain via vanilla techs). 2.13 - SINGLE CENSUS QUEST: replaced the 26 individual listener quests with ONE persistent visible quest "DustbornsCensus" (starts turn 3 for Dustborns, no Choice, no modal): ObjectiveSet ObjectiveComposition="All" with 26 objectives (one per planet type incl. 6 gas giants) - each objective completes when a planet of that type is first fully depleted, grants its reward (rich +2/+4 dust, moderate +1/+2 + 10-turn buff via QuestEffect, poor/gas unique bonuses) and fires the standard objective-completed notification with the reward text in the objective name; the quest stays active until ALL 26 types are devoured, serving as the world-devouring tracker. Removed old DustbornsCatalogListener* quests/GUI/localization keys; added %DustbornsCensusTitle/Description/Outcome and 26 %Census_(Type)Title keys. 2.12 - QUIET NOTIFICATIONS: removed the single-option Choice popup from all 26 census quests (it caused the modal "Solo quest started" window); quests now start silently as regular quests - the game shows normal feed notifications ("new quest" then "quest completed" with the reward text from OutcomeCompleted), no modal window. Reward still granted in StartActions on quest start. 2.11 - VISIBLE EVENT QUESTS FOR CENSUS: hidden quests show NO notification in ES2, so all 26 census listeners were converted into VISIBLE BeginTurn event quests with a Choice popup (single option "Accept the lesson" - %DustbornsCatalogChoiceTitle) triggered by an InterpreterPrerequisite on first full depletion of that planet type; reward+quest effect are applied in ObjectiveSet StartActions when the player confirms, so the popup reliably shows title, lore+reward text and grants the reward (same mechanism as vanilla random events and main quest chapters). 2.10 - NOTIFICATIONS VIA QUEST COMPLETION: Action_Message removed (unreliable - kept showing "missing GuiElement"); each of the 26 census listener quests now has a proper QuestGuiElement (name = quest name) with Title, Description, Objective and OutcomeCompleted, so the game shows its standard quest-completion notification (same mechanism as vanilla Deeds) with the reward text - 26 new localization keys %DustbornsCatalogListener_(Type)_Outcome. 2.09 - MESSAGE GUI FIX: Action_Message now passes the BARE GuiElement name (was %LocalizationKey) and 26 new ExtendedGuiElements "DustbornsCatalogListener_(Type)_Message" were added (Title=%..._MessageTitle short header, Description=%..._Message full lore+reward text) - fixes "missing GuiElement" debug text shown instead of the notification after depleting a world. 2.08 - CENSUS OF WORLDS REDESIGN: each planet type now gives a PREDETERMINED reward (no choice) on first full depletion, applied by 26 hidden listener quests (was 16): rich worlds (Atoll/Forest/Ocean/Terran) +2/+4 dust harvest; moderate worlds (Boreal/Mediterranean/Monsoon/Jungle/Savannah/Steppes/Tundra/Arctic/Snow/Arid/Desert) +1/+2 dust harvest PLUS a one-time +10% resource buff for 10 turns (new QuestEffectDefinitions plugin, Action_ApplyQuestEffect); poor worlds unique permanent features - Ice: -0.05 depletion per Dustborn, Ash: Bezvolny +3 industry on depleted worlds, Lava: Bezvolny +1 industry, Barren: +4 science per Dustborn while world is depleting, Toxic: +1 dust per Dustborn; gas giants (Burning/Hot/Warm/Temperate/Cold/Frozen) unique bonuses. Removed shared DustbornCatalogPlanets counter and DustbornCatalogPlanetEntry (Primary trait growth and Miserly Wisdom no longer scale from the counter; Meager base fixed at 2). PATIENT WINDS FIX: tech now sets DustbornPatientWindsReduction=0.1 property on the Primary trait instead of the broken count-entity path - the subtraction happens in the trait (0.1 x Dustborns on planet). New listeners use wiki PlanetType names (Steppes, Ice, Snow, Boreal, Monsoon, Mediterranean, Savannah, Gas*); old Asteroid/Steppe/Frozen listeners removed - verify names in Public/Simulation if a type never fires. 26 new notification messages. 2.07 - SHELLS IMMUNE TO RE-DIGESTION: AffinityBezvolny and AffinityBezvolnyScholar now IsInvincible=true - "Convert to Bezvolny" and "Convert to Scholar" no longer target already-digested shells; both improvements additionally check (Population - MajorPopulationCount - BezvolnyCount - ScholarCount) gt 0 so the button disables when only shells remain. PATIENT WINDS FIX: TechnologyDustbornDepletion1 no longer applies a flat -0.1 to every planet; it now reduces PlanetDepletionPerTurn by 0.1 per Dustborn on that planet (BinaryModifier x PopulationCount via ClassPopulationPlanetAffinityDustbornsCount, SearchValueFromPath). CENSUS NOTIFICATIONS: all 16 hidden "Census of Worlds" listener quests now fire Action_Message on first full depletion of each planet type - player gets a popup with lore text and the reward note (+2/+4 dust harvest per catalog entry); 16 new localization keys. 1.16 - TECH EFFECTS FIX: all technology SimulationDescriptor modifiers now use Path="../ClassEmpire/..." (from Research object) - previously Path="ClassEmpire/..." silently failed, so techs showed text but had no effect (food-to-dust, digestion +300, depletion -0.1, shells +2 industry). T1 "First Hunger" is now a Chapter 1 quest reward (Action_UnlockTechnology) instead of a tree tech (Visibility=Hidden), alongside the 200 dust - food-to-dust no longer starts from turn 1 and only unlocks after completing Chapter 1. CONVERT TO BEZVOLNY: rewritten using the vanilla Horatio "Clone Major Population" pattern (PopulationSource="Minor", PopulationDestinationHeuristic="LowestCount", correct path ColonizedStarSystemStateColony/ClassColonizedPlanet/PopulationNonMajor, NotEnoughPopulation prerequisite) - the improvement now appears when minors share a planet with Dustborns. CENSUS OF WORLDS: added 16 hidden quest listeners (one per planet type) that apply DustbornCatalogPlanetEntry to the empire when a planet of that type is first fully depleted - dust harvest now grows 4/8 -> 6/12 -> 8/16... per unique depleted planet type. 1.15 - QUESTS DEPLETION: "deplete N planets" objectives (Chapter2-B, 3-A/B/C, 5-B) rewritten to the canonical Condition_IsProgressionComplete pattern with InterpretedVar Start/End counts (official ExampleSimpleQuests style) - the counter now advances per depleted planet, not per turn; added PlanetTypeAsh to the "hot" branch (3-B). FOOD TECH: added T1 technology TechnologyDustbornFoodToDust0 "First Hunger" (era 1, Economy and Trade) that UNLOCKS the food-to-dust mechanic (+25%); removed the built-in 25% from the population trait (conversion no longer works from turn 1); chain is now 0->1->2->3 with TechnologyLink 0-1 and -25% cost reduction; added GUI + localization. TOOLTIP: added %SystemGrowthTitle localization so the conversion tooltip no longer shows the raw key. 1.14 - QUESTS GUI: added QuestGuiElement (with ExtraType) - quests now display name/text/objective/reward; Prerequisites now use Target="$(Empire)" + PathPrerequisite EmpireTypeMajor/ClassPopulation,ClassPopulationEmpireAffinityDustborns,PopulationMajor (official ExampleSimpleQuests pattern); removed Chapter0 launcher (Chapter1 self-gated via Prerequisites, BeginTurn, MinimumTurn=3); ScholarShells is now a Solo quest with the same faction gate - no longer fires for all factions. TECH BRANCHES: technologies now require the previous one (TechnologyPrerequisite Flags="Prerequisite,Link,Disable"); added TechnologyLinkDefinitions (+DatabasePlugin) that draw the branch lines and give -25% cost (official ExampleTechnology pattern); custom cost formulas rebuilt correctly. 1.13 - TECH TREE: techs moved into real quadrants (Digestion=Empire Development, FoodToDust=Economy and Trade, Depletion/Shells=Science and Exploration) with correct stage/category/cost/count descriptors; vertical chains: FoodToDust1->2->3, Digestion1->2->3, Depletion1->Shells1. QUESTS: rewritten objectives to proven element names (Decorator_ConstructionCompleted+Input_ConstructionName, Condition_CheckInterpreter+Input_Context/Input_Expression); restored hidden Chapter0 launcher (MinimumTurn=3) as the faction gate; all quest filters now use ClassEmpire,AffinityMappingDustborns instead of the broken population-count path - main quest appears on turn 3 for Dustborns only, side quest ScholarShells no longer fires for all factions. 1.12 - TECH TREE: techs now use TechnologyGuiElement2 with X/Y (were invisible in the tree); added TechnologyGuiElement2 to GuiElement plugin ExtraTypes; added icons. FOOD: rewrote food-to-dust (v6): money = SystemGrowth*0.25 written directly to SystemMoney, DisableFoodConversion=1 stops food->industry; removed the SystemProductionFromGrowth hack that caused food->industry; techs add +25% each. QUESTS: removed redundant Chapter0 launcher (started Chapter1 on turn 1 over the game intro); added faction Prerequisites to all chapters. 1.11 - CRASH FIX: Droplists rewritten to correct ES2 format (Resource with Quantity, no DroppableStack); removed invalid ExtraType 'DroppableStack' from Dustborns.xml; added GuiElement/localization for tech category CategoryTechnologyFactionDustborns. 1.10 - Fixed half industry via PlanetPopulationIndustry Percent -0.5, added home improvement to spawn Bezvolny, Standard true for Bezvolny, removed politics, dust bonus via tags Meager/Teeming * BonusFromDepletion
